name: Strabismus Spotlight
description: Esotropia, exotropia, vertical deviations, incomitant strabismus, amblyopia treatment, vergence disorders, convergence insufficiency, and vision therapy principles.

episodes.title: Eye Movements: The Six Muscles and Their Actions
episodes.description: The cardinal positions of gaze and the primary, secondary, and tertiary actions of each muscle.

episodes.title: Tropia Versus Phoria: The Manifest and the Latent
episodes.description: The cover-uncover and the alternate cover, the manifest versus latent, and the control that distinguishes.

episodes.title: Comitant Versus Incomitant: The Deviation That Changes
episodes.description: The same deviation in all gazes versus the direction-dependent — and the palsy and restriction causes.

episodes.title: Esotropia: The Inward Turn and the Subtypes
episodes.description: Infantile, accommodative, acquired — the age of onset and the refractive error that guide the workup.

episodes.title: Accommodative Esotropia: The High Plus and the Bifocal
episodes.description: The AC/A ratio, the full plus correction, and the bifocal that reduces the near deviation.

episodes.title: Infantile Esotropia: The Surgery Before Age Two
episodes.description: The large angle, the cross-fixation, and the early surgery for binocular potential.

episodes.title: Exotropia: The Outward Turn and the Intermittent
episodes.description: The intermittent XT that decompensates in fatigue and distance and the surgical threshold.

episodes.title: Convergence Insufficiency: The Near Exophoria
episodes.description: The near point of convergence, the exophoria at near, and the office-based vision therapy evidence.

episodes.title: Vertical Deviations: Hyper and Hypotropia
episodes.description: The dissociated vertical deviation, the superior oblique overaction, and the thyroid and restriction.

episodes.title: Superior Oblique Palsy: The Head Tilt and the Parks Three-Step
episodes.description: The compensatory head tilt, the three-step test, and the congenital versus acquired distinction.

episodes.title: Inferior Oblique Overaction: The V-Pattern and the Surgery
episodes.description: The elevation in adduction, the V-pattern, and the weakening procedure that aligns.

episodes.title: Duane Syndrome: The Congenital Miswiring
episodes.description: The limited abduction, the narrowing of the palpebral fissure, and the head turn compensation.

episodes.title: Brown Syndrome: The Superior Oblique Tightness
episodes.description: The inability to elevate in adduction, the click, and the congenital versus acquired causes.

episodes.title: Möbius Syndrome: The Congenital Facial and Abducens Palsy
episodes.description: The mask-like face, the absent abduction, and the multidisciplinary care.

episodes.title: Restrictive Strabismus: Thyroid and Post-Trauma
episodes.description: The forced duction test, the restrictive versus paretic, and the surgery that addresses the mechanism.

episodes.title: Amblyopia: The Sensory Consequence of Strabismus
episodes.description: The cortical suppression, the amblyopia risk, and the patching and atropine that treat it.

episodes.title: Prism for Strabismus: The Relief and the Limit
episodes.description: Fresnel and ground-in, the adaptation test, and the threshold for surgical referral.

episodes.title: Vision Therapy: The Evidence and the Application
episodes.description: The convergence insufficiency treatment trial, the office-based protocol, and the patient selection.

episodes.title: Strabismus Surgery: The Recession and Resection
episodes.description: The muscle detachment and shortening, the adjustable suture, and the post-op alignment.

episodes.title: Adjustable Sutures: The Post-Op Fine-Tuning
episodes.description: The awake adjustment, the timing, and the patient cooperation that makes it possible.

episodes.title: Botulinum Toxin for Strabismus: The Chemical Denervation
episodes.description: The injection alternative to surgery, the transient effect, and the selective use.

episodes.title: Adult Strabismus: The Function and the Cosmesis
episodes.description: The diplopia, the psychosocial impact, and the surgery that restores both.

episodes.title: Diplopia: The Workup Beyond the Cover Test
episodes.description: The monocular versus binocular, the imaging, and the myasthenia and thyroid screens.

episodes.title: Convergence Excess: The Near Esotropia
episodes.description: The high AC/A, the near deviation, and the bifocal and surgery decision.

episodes.title: Divergence Excess: The Distance Exotropia
episodes.description: The distance greater than near, the measurement challenge, and the surgical planning.

episodes.title: A and V Patterns: The Vertical Incomitance
episodes.description: The horizontal deviation that changes with upgaze and downgaze and the oblique muscle role.

episodes.title: Nystagmus and Strabismus: The Combined Challenge
episodes.description: The infantile nystagmus, the null point, and the abnormal head posture and surgery.

episodes.title: Post-Stroke Strabismus: The Acquired Diplopia
episodes.description: The CN palsy after stroke, the prism and patching bridge, and the recovery timeline.

episodes.title: Pediatric Strabismus: The Family Communication
episodes.description: The patching adherence, the surgery anxiety, and the long-term binocular potential conversation.

episodes.title: Strabismus Follow-Up: The Alignment Maintenance
episodes.description: The post-op drift, the amblyopia surveillance, and the refractive update that sustains alignment.
